target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, virtio-ramfb, 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, VirtIO keyboard/tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-3d-utm-qemu-exact-current.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-3d-apps

GrModels Ball generated a 58-vertex, 128-triangle mesh; 536 purple inline-sprite pixels were visible in the graphical terminal.
KeepAway rendered its court, HUD and player, accepted mouse and Space input, and returned to the terminal without leaving an Animate task.
Titanium displayed gameplay, accepted input, and Escape restored a working terminal.
Post-app terminal, compiler, launch, and window-demo regression checks completed with exit code 0.
